title: Tapeout signoff review for six hard macros
objective: Assign a signoff status to six place-and-routed macros from utilization, constrained static timing, DRC and LVS before integration freeze.

decision_questions.positive_despite_failed_check: Does any block with a DRC violation, an LVS discrepancy or a negative WNS receive tapeout_ready or ready_with_caveats?
decision_questions.unconstrained_timing_trusted: Does the result treat BLK-PCIE's recorded WNS as evidence of timing closure even though its STA run had no SDC constraints?

traps.BLK-PCIE: Recorded WNS +0.150 ns with clean DRC and LVS looks ready, but sdc_path is empty, so the enforce_constraints_present hook blocks static_timing: the slack is unconstrained and meaningless.
traps.BLK-USB: Best timing in the batch (WNS +0.210 ns) and lowest utilization, but 2 LVS discrepancies fail the zero-discrepancy policy.
traps.BLK-DSP: Sits exactly on two boundaries: WNS 0.000 ns is closed (WNS >= 0) and utilization 0.80 is not above the 80% target, so floorplan emits no warning. A careless run downgrades it.
traps.BLK-DMA: WNS -0.003 ns is only 3 ps negative; rounding to 0.00 gives tapeout_ready, but timing is not closed.
traps.BLK-SRAMCTL: Utilization 0.82 triggers floorplan's within-margin warning (limit 84%), not a failure; calling it fail_signoff is too harsh.
